component.name: VSCodium Rust
component.summary: Native GPU-accelerated Code Editor & Security IDE

description.p: VSCodium Rust is an ultra-fast, native GPU-accelerated code editor and IDE built with the GPUI framework and tailored for security researchers, penetration testers, and reverse engineers on Parrot Security OS.

Features integrated reverse engineering suites (Ghidra, IDA MCP), mobile security auditing (MobSF, Frida instrumentation), hardware-accelerated terminal emulation, and offline zero-telemetry local AI assistants.
